digest.component_or_area: test subprocess environment handling and exception rendering
propositions: 103 non-fixture test-local subprocess environments constructed from os.environ as broad dict/spread/copy forms can leak inherited credentials in pytest long tracebacks when process startup fails
pytest exception rendering applies saferepr to subprocess.run kwargs and env parameters, serializing ordinary dict representations of os.environ
A mutable dict subclass with redacted __repr__ preserves exact subprocess semantics and child inheritance while preventing credential disclosure in default-long tracebacks
An AST policy guard must reject both raw broad environment constructors and unsafe boundary unwrapping to prevent regressions across the 110-site test population
The redacted environment mapping solution preserves all key/value/order semantics, intentional ambient propagation, and passes full test suite without weakening existing behaviors
